# Product Context — Cabinly

## What it is
A website for booking holiday cabins, for groups of friends or families and for the owners
who rent cabins out. Guests find a cabin that fits their group and dates; owners keep their
calendars in order. Made-up fixture for uxos tests.

## Scope (this product)
**In scope:** searching and booking cabins; owners managing availability.
**Out of scope:** payments processing itself (a provider handles it) — needs verification.
